notes.title: From the Kitchen to the Battlefield
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45079619/31ea2eaae9b8163edf9b06cddeb4ed9935acb91b.png[/img]

Hello everyone!

It’s been a while! We hope your culinary adventures have been going well. Today, we’re bringing you some exciting news—[b]something BIG is coming in the next few months![/b]

But first, we want to express our heartfelt gratitude for your incredible support. Over the past five months, [b]Shokudo Underworld[/b] has sold over 8,000 copies—a milestone we never expected to reach as an indie team. From the bottom of our hearts, thank you for being part of this journey.

As a small startup, our team consists of two co-leaders—one specializing in coding and the other in art—a game designer, a music producer, and, of course, me, the mascot! 😊 Shokudo Underworld was our first game, a way to explore the market and test our potential. Since launch, we’ve received amazing feedback from players—ranging from bug reports to creative suggestions—and we’ve carefully considered every one of them to improve the gaming experience.

Now, with all the lessons we’ve learned, we’re thrilled to announce our next project: [b]Rise of Shrooms![/b]

This brand-new casual game is completely different from Shokudo Underworld. Rise of Shrooms is a turn-based strategy game set on a grid-based battlefield, where every move and action is determined by the roll of the dice. This time, you’re not the hero—you’re leading the mushrooms as they spread their spores, conquer new lands, and take on fierce monsters (and even a legendary boss… but I won’t spoil too much, or my boss will get mad! 😆).

We’ve made sure to keep the gameplay challenging yet rewarding, packed with surprises to keep things fresh. Our amazing artist has once again brought the world to life with charming cartoony characters that we can’t wait for you to meet!

To make the game even better, [b]we’ll be releasing a demo on February 24 as part of Steam Next Fest![/b] This is your chance to try it out early and share your thoughts. We’d love to hear your feedback, especially on game balancing and mechanics.

Stay tuned for more updates, and thank you again for being part of our adventure!

See you soon in [b]Rise of Shrooms[/b]! 🍄✨

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3344870/Rise_of_Shrooms/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45079619/d4faf4dcfe813cf89c5e915fbd516b302b56a156.png[/img]

[h3]What is "Shokudo"[/h3]
Shokudo culture refers to the casual dining experience associated with shokudo, or informal eateries in Japan. These establishments offer a variety of affordable, home-style meals, making them popular among students, workers, and families. The atmosphere is relaxed and inviting, encouraging diners to enjoy a quick meal or a leisurely gathering with friends and loved ones. Menus typically feature an array of dishes, including sushi, rice bowls, noodles, and seasonal ingredients, reflecting regional and cultural influences. With a focus on reasonable pricing, shokudo are accessible to a wide audience and often emphasize the use of fresh, local ingredients, celebrating the flavors of the region. Additionally, some shokudo incorporate elements from other cuisines, showcasing Japan's openness to culinary diversity. Overall, shokudo culture embodies a warm, inclusive approach to dining that values both nourishment and community. 

In Shokudo Underworld, we bring you the most immersive shokudo experience imaginable!  Whether you are a student struggling with tests, assignments, and future challenges, a worker completing an infinite amount of tasks, or a group of friends or families looking for a unique way to bond, our game invites you to dive into a whimsical kitchen like no other. It is fun for everyone and perfect for players of all ages!

Join our community and connect with fellow chefs and share your best cooking moments!

Happy Cooking!
Miluku Inc.

notes.title: Cooking Up Changes: Shokudo Underworld Adds More Space and Music!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45079619/da157afcf200e711b3737a5d3ecd246777a1f968.png[/img]
Hello, fellow chefs!

First of all, we want to express our heartfelt thanks for your amazing support. The game has now sold over 3,000 copies worldwide! As a small startup team, this means everything to us, and we couldn't be more grateful.

In the two weeks since launch, we’ve received so much feedback, and we've gone through every bit of it. Your lovely comments about the game's coziness, the cute art, and the music made us so happy, and your suggestions for improving gameplay and mechanics have been incredibly helpful. We’ve heard you loud and clear and are excited to announce some updates based on your requests! In this update, we’re adding more backpack space and some new music to the game. Just like our slogan says, the new track is “Freshly Brewed” by our amazing musician, and we hope you enjoy it!

We’d also like to address some of the big questions we’ve been getting about Shokudo Underworld:
[olist]
[b][*] Will there be a mobile, Nintendo Switch, or other platform version soon?[/b]
Unfortunately, the short answer is no. Shokudo Underworld was initially designed just for PC, and we didn't plan for other platforms. That said, we’ve heard how much you’d love to play it elsewhere, and we agree it would be a great fit. However, at the moment, there aren’t plans to expand to other platforms.

[b][*] Is there controller support for this game?[/b]
We didn't specifically design the game for controllers, but we've heard many of you are using Steam Deck and other controllers to play, which is awesome! While it’s not officially supported, it seems to be working for some players.
[/olist]
Thank you so much for being part of our chefing journey!

[h3]All rise, gamers. Let’s give a thunderous round of applause and welcome the arrival of our new game, [i]Shokudo Underworld[/i]. Limited-Time Discount! Grab your game now and enjoy a [b]10% discount[/b]—available for [b]one week[/b] ONLY![/h3]

[h2]Challenge Your Foodie Palate[/h2]
[i]Shokudo Underworld[/i] is a 2.5D restaurant management game where you play as a corporate worker serving food to Underworld customers. Use a variety of strange underground ingredients to create delicious and bizarre dishes that will tantalize your customers' taste buds. As you earn more salary, you can pray to the gods to unlock new skills and tools, which will help you upgrade your restaurant and provide even better service.

[h2]Feature Spotlights[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]The Mystical Shokudo[/b]: Serve up delicious dishes on time to earn tips, experience, and cute gacha prizes. Meanwhile, make wishes to the gods and harness their divine power to upgrade your restaurant and attract more customers!
[*] [b]The Quirky and Eerie Art[/b]: Delight in the most “adorable” cartoon characters and immerse yourself in an authentic restaurant environment with a mystical atmosphere.
[*] [b]The Enchanting Music[/b]: Experience an original soundtrack with Japanese shokudo themes that transport you to a magical world.
[/list]
[h2]Game Lore[/h2]
The story unfolds with a depressed corporate worker who meets his untimely end in a restaurant accident. In his final moments, he dreams of one last taste of his favorite ramen, hoping to find it in the afterlife. But instead of a heavenly feast, he is met with a surprising twist: he is reincarnated as a corporate worker once more, but this time in the depths of the Underworld.

In this new realm, he runs a bustling shokudo for Underworld residents. He must source rare, magical ingredients from a farm inhabited by mythical creatures and enchanted vegetables, then turn them into dishes for his otherworldly customers. Overwhelmed by tasks and challenges, he needs your help to turn his misfortune into success. Will you assist him in the afterlife?

[h2]Tips and Tricks[/h2]
[list]
[*] Zoom zoom! Gotta run up and down quickly. Better carry an extra backpack too.
[*] The more variety you have in the food menu, the more experience you gain. However, you need to carefully time your service and gather ingredients.
[*] What da cat doing? Rub its belly and see what happens.
[/list]
[h2]About Our Team - Miluku Inc.[/h2]
[b][i]Freshly brewed games, straight from the source![/i][/b]

We are a new indie game studio founded by four passionate university graduates. While none of us studied game design, our shared dream of crafting a fantastical world inspired us to start this studio, and the excitement of bringing our vision to life continues to fuel our motivation.

Contact Information: miluku.inc@gmail.com
